name: ai-dev-kit
description: Skill-first AI development workflow kit for agent harnesses

scripts.build: bash -n bootstrap/init-skill.sh bootstrap/install-adapter.sh bootstrap/install-skill.sh scripts/skill-first-gate.sh tests/fake-cascade tests/run-gate-tests.sh tests/lease-redis-test.sh && python3 -c "compile(open('scripts/quick-validate-skill.py').read(), 'scripts/quick-validate-skill.py', 'exec')" && for d in skills/*; do test -f "$d/SKILL.md"; done && node -c scripts/generate-skill-profile.cjs && node -c scripts/upgrade-v1-to-skill.cjs && node -c scripts/set-coordination.cjs && node -c scripts/test-review-evidence.cjs && node -c scripts/cascade-process.cjs && node -c scripts/cascade-lane.cjs && node -c scripts/project-gate-evidence.cjs && node -c scripts/resource-lock.cjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['marketplace/index.json','.claude-plugin/marketplace.json','.claude-plugin/plugin.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))" && npm run test:review && npm run test:team && FAST=1 bash tests/run-gate-tests.sh
scripts.test: npm run test:review && npm run test:team && bash tests/run-gate-tests.sh
scripts.test:fast: npm run test:review && npm run test:team && FAST=1 bash tests/run-gate-tests.sh
scripts.test:team: node --test tests/cascade-center-config.test.cjs tests/cascade-process.test.cjs tests/team-gate-contract.test.cjs tests/gate-process-boundary.test.cjs tests/cascade-flow.test.cjs tests/cascade-portal.test.cjs tests/resource-lock.test.cjs
